text:
julie_procurement: Vendor called — APAC A800 allocation delayed. They can split: 30 brand-new units by air (7d, premium), 30 refurbished loaners on next flight (3d), or full sea bulk (21d). Vendor asks if we want loaners + partial air or wait. Need decision — affects Dedicated APAC pool SLOs.

maria_ops: FYI APAC dedicated pool is at 92% util this week. If we lose 30 units we risk throttling canaries for customers on capacity commits. :grimacing:

sam_sre: If we take loaners we have to be explicit about firmware/thermal parity. Loaners often have mixed firmware and could blow up warm-start regression tests. Can ops/integration do a quick burn-in?

david_logistics: Customs note: loaners arriving as "temporary import" need a T1/TIR doc in some APAC markets, plus vendor must supply serial manifest and return AWB. That adds 24–48h if not pre-filed.

alina_vendor: Confirming loaners are refurbished R0-R1 tested, 30-day warranty on loaners, refundable deposit 2% per unit. Air new units premium = +$3000/unit for 7d air. Sea full batch has no premium but 21d ETA. We can produce serialized manifest and photos within 6 hours.

julie_procurement: Can you put the deposit/refund terms in writing and confirm who holds deposit (vendor escrow vs Redwood credit)? Also need credit note if we later convert loaners to permanent units.

finance_bot: Quick calc: deposit = 2% * unit_price. If unit_price = $45k, deposit/unit = $900. 30 loaners => $27k hold. Premium for 30 air new = 30 * $3000 = $90k.

maria_ops: Operational ask: if we accept loaners we require a burn-in at depot for 48h and an automated firmware parity check. If any fail, vendor must pick up under RMA within 72h. Otherwise we escalate to depot replacement.

david_logistics: Proposed shipping split we can execute: 20 new via 7d air (priority), 20 loaners on next flight (3d), remaining 20 sea. That smooths customs load and reduces immediate deposit exposure. I'll need serial ranges for the loaners to pre-file TE docs.

alina_vendor: We can do that split. Provide manifest sample here: 

```
AWB: 123-45678901
LOANER_SERIALS: A800-L-0001..A800-L-0020
NEW_SERIALS: A800-N-0101..A800-N-0120
```

Terms: loaners under temporary import, deposit refundable within 14 days after return inspection, vendor covers initial crossdock photos.

sam_sre: Approve split approach if engineering gets burn-in + parity check gate. Also request automatic routing change: non-sensitive traffic for APAC can fallback to eu-west for 48h if capacity drops below 85%. Need ops signoff on that feature flag.

julie_procurement: Sounds reasonable. @finance_bot confirm hold accounting and any P&L treatment. Also @alina_vendor we need the refund timing in the legal addendum. If vendor won't sign, we can't use loaners for customer-paid Dedicated pools.

finance_bot: Accounting note: deposit is a liability hold until refunded or applied. Recommend escrow via vendor partner so Redwood balance sheet not impacted. Will follow up with AP invoice flow.

david_logistics: I'll create shipping instructions and pre-file temporary import docs as soon as manifest received. Creating ticket OPS-1427 and tagging customs team.

maria_ops: Also: add acceptance criteria for loaners: 
- burn-in logs show <0.5% error rate over 48h
- thermal throttle within baseline
- firmware <= target build.
If any fail, immediate RMA pickup at vendor cost.

alina_vendor: Acknowledged on acceptance criteria, will send sample test report and sign addendum. We can provide pickup labels for failing units.

julie_procurement: Decision: proceed with split (20 air new / 20 loaners / 20 sea) conditional on vendor-signed addendum + escrow deposit. Deadline EOD for vendor confirmation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

shipbot: Shipping request created (OPS-1427). ETA manifests pending vendor upload.

maria_ops: I'll schedule the parity tests and hold the rollout gates until we see burn-in.

alina_vendor: Uploading manifest now, will DM the contract link.

julie_procurement: Great — final signoff once contract + escrow confirmed.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from maria_ops, :white_check_mark: from sam_sre)
